The '''Battle of Spirana''' was an engagement in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] liberation campaign after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="TEA" />

After the end of the [[Nagai–Tof War]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] launched its main liberation campaign against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[New Republic Fourth Fleet]] was tasked to reconquer the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. After the Republic [[Milagro campaign|victory]] at [[Milagro/Legends|Milagro]], Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Uther Kermen]] retreated to [[Spirana/Legends|Spirana]] from where he launched a [[Battle in the Milagro system|raid]] on Milagro. Admiral [[Voon Massa]] immediately ordered the attack of the planet.<ref name="TEGTW" />

After the battle, the New Republic discovered information that there were still about ten thousand [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]] unaccounted for after major Imperial [[Battle of Endor/Legends|defeat]].<ref name="LSatSoM" />
